verdict.rationale: Extend's docs reference Async Processing, Workflows, Webhooks, and SDK/CLI/API access, which together imply support for processing many documents at scale, but there is no explicit documentation of a batch/bulk endpoint or a stated bulk-item limit for AI-native automation. Missing for 10: explicit batch API/endpoint documentation, examples of bulk job submission across many documents, and any hands-on confirmation of large-scale batch throughput.
